rules.sentence: Patent foramen ovale (PFO), also known as persistent foramen ovale, is a condition in which the foramen ovale, a naturally occurring opening in the atrial septum of the developing fetus, fails to close after birth.

Among individuals who participate in aquatic diving, this condition has been associated with severe, sudden-onset neurological decompression sickness, inner ear decompression sickness, and cutis marmorata.[1][2][3]
